{{PrevNext| prev=Be a Hero | next=Under The Alolan Sun | list=English opening themes | colorscheme=XYZ}} {{Song| type=Dub OP 19 | language=en | title=Stand Tall | screen=hd | screenshot=OPE19.png | artistname=Ben Dixon and The Sad Truth | lyricistname=[[Ed Goldfarb]] | composername=[[Ed Goldfarb]] | arrangername=[[Ed Goldfarb]] and Akhil Gopal | albumtype=album | albumtitle=[[Pokémon Movie Music Collection]] | catalognumber=N/A | recordcompany=Pokémon | colorscheme=XYZ}} '''Stand Tall''' is the opening theme song for the English [[dub]] of the nineteenth [[season]], [[S19|Pokémon the Series: XYZ]]. It was used from ''[[XY094|From A to Z!]]'' to ''[[XYS05|The Legend of X, Y, and Z!]]''. The opening animation is composed of clips from the third ''[[Pokémon the Series: XY]]'' Japanese opening {{so|XY&Z}}. [[Squishy]]) * {{p|Zygarde}} ({{DL|List of Pokémon with form differences|Zygarde|Zygarde 50%}}; [[Z2]]) ==Opening animation spoilers== * [[Sawyer's Grovyle]] evolves into a {{p|Sceptile}} and is able to [[Mega Evolution|Mega Evolve]]. ==Video== {{youtubevid|LCNHc12volU&t{{=}}1m|Pokémon|color=A1D175|colordark=6FB82B|colorlight=6FB82B}} ==Trivia== * This song [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8y0YUt6gpXk was uploaded] to the official {{pmin|the United States|Cartoon Network}} YouTube channel on April 20, 2016. * The opening animation wasn't updated to include [[Ash's Noivern]]. * An instrumental version of this song was used in ''[[XY105|Party Dancecapades!]]'', ''[[XY106|A Meeting of Two Journeys!]]'', ''[[XY114|A Keeper for Keeps?]]'', ''[[XY116|The Synchronicity Test!]]'', ''[[XY121|Seeing the Forest for the Trees!]]'', ''[[XY122|A Real Icebreaker!]]'', ''[[XY128|A Riveting Rivalry!]]'', ''[[XY133|Coming Apart at the Dreams!]]'', ''[[XY135|Rocking Kalos Defenses!]]'', and ''[[XY139|Facing the Needs of the Many!]]''. * This is the first English opening theme to not have the lyric "Pokémon" in the last line of the song. * The movie version has a violin playing during the instrumental break, but it is only present in the English audio track and not in any international versions. ==In other languages== {{Epilang|color=A1D175|bordercolor=6FB82B |cs={{DL|List of Czech Pokémon themes|To já vím}} ''I know that'' |da={{DL|List of Danish Pokémon themes|Jeg' Stolt}} ''I'm Proud'' |nl={{DL|List of Dutch Pokémon themes|Ik sta sterk}} ''I stand strong'' |fi={{DL|List of Finnish Pokémon themes|Pelkää en}} ''I'm not afraid'' |fr_eu={{DL|List of French Pokémon themes|Je suis fier}} ''I am proud'' |de={{DL|List of German Pokémon themes|Ich bin stark}} ''I am strong'' |it={{DL|List of Italian Pokémon themes|Non mi arrendo}} ''I don't give up'' |he={{DL|List of Hebrew Pokémon themes|מוכן לקרב}} ''Ready for battle''
